villains.name: The Headless Horseman
villains.legend: A Hessian trooper who lost his head to a cannonball. He rides at night looking for it, and throws a flaming jack-o'-lantern in its place.
villains.powerBlurb: hurl a flaming jack-o'-lantern that bursts in a ring of fear

villains.name: The Banshee
villains.legend: A pale spirit whose wail foretells a death in the family. Hearing it means trouble.
villains.powerBlurb: a scream heard through walls: big fear, flashlights knocked out

villains.name: Stingy Jack
villains.origin: Irish folk tale, the first jack-o'-lantern
villains.legend: He tricked the Devil twice, so neither Heaven nor Hell would have him. He wanders with a coal in a carved turnip: the will-o'-the-wisp.
villains.powerBlurb: three wisps drift out and hunt Solvers; a flashlight pops them

villains.name: Baba Yaga
villains.legend: The bony-legged witch of the deep woods. She flies in a mortar, steers with a pestle and curses anyone who wanders too close to her hut.
villains.powerBlurb: curse the nearest Solver: fear spikes and their flashlight drains
